verdict.rationale: Buzz ships a full CLI (buzz-cli), a headless agent runtime (buzz-agent, 'stdio in, tool calls out') designed for 'headless autonomous coding work', an ACP harness (buzz-acp) that runs agents unattended against relay events, Helm/Docker-compose deployment bundles for server automation, and a public benchmark harness (Harbor) for CI-style automated grading — together covering headless/CI operation end-to-end. missing for 10: no explicit GitHub Actions/CI-pipeline example or independent hands-on confirmation that a full workflow runs unattended in a CI runner.
